entries.say.variants.default: Everyone's snapping at each other over the watch schedule and the pantry, {addressee.name}. We need to sort this out before someone walks out.
entries.reply.reconciled.say.variants.default: Alright, {addressee.name}. We're all tired and short on sleep. Let's split the watch evenly and drop it.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.default: Fine. Let's cool off and talk about it after we've both had some water and rest.
entries.reply.acknowledged.say.variants.default: I hear you, {addressee.name}. Nobody's trying to shortchange anyone here—we just need clearer rules.
entries.reply.strained.say.variants.default: Forget it. Not much point talking when nobody's listening.
